Punjab CM Addresses Regional Youth Festival in Dhuri

Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Singh Mann stated that the state government has provided over 70,000 government jobs to youth purely on the basis of merit, without any bribery or special requests. The Chief Minister made these remarks while interacting with young attendees during a regional youth festival held at Desh Bhagat College in village Baradwal, located within the Dhuri assembly constituency.

Highlighting the state's educational development, the Chief Minister stated that Punjab is being transformed into a major center of education and that funds for the improvement of government schools will not face any shortages. He encouraged students to focus entirely on their studies and hard work, assuring them that the state administration stands with them at every step.

Event Highlights and Participation

According to the details shared from the event:

  • Participation: Students from 39 colleges took part in the regional youth festival.
  • Activities: A total of 60 different activities were conducted across four stages, showcasing cultural and literary talents.
  • Organizers: The Chief Minister appreciated the contributions of Punjabi University, Patiala, and its Youth Welfare Department for organizing youth festivals over several decades.

Official Notification and Verification Status

  • Issuing Authority: Government of Punjab
  • Notification ID: Not specified
  • Posts/Exam: General government employment figures reported by the administration
  • Eligibility, Age Cut-Off Date, Vacancies, Fees, Application Dates, and Selection Stages: Not specified in the official address context.
